summary: York Space Systems Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire All.Space Holdings, Inc. for $355 million in a combination of cash and stock. At closing, York will pay approximately $155 million in cash and issue up to 5.9 million shares of its common stock, with customary adjustments for cash, debt, transaction expenses, and working capital. An adjustment escrow ($5M), reorganization indemnification escrow ($1.5M), special indemnification escrow (BGP 750k converted to USD), and an expense reserve ($1M) are established. The acquisition will be effected through a series of contributions making All.Space an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the filing. Watch for shareholder approvals, regulatory clearances, and potential competing bids as closing conditions.
